Database sync now supports PostgreSQL 16 and MySQL 8.3
Admin console audit log retention extended to 7 years
Client auto-update now supports staged rollouts
bugfixes: SYNC-712: Fixed deadlock in multi-threaded sync engine
SYNC-723: Fixed incorrect timestamp during DST transitions
SYNC-734: Fixed WebDAV transport authentication loop
SYNC-745: Fixed memory pressure during large file delta computation
breaking_changes: Deprecated v1 WebSocket protocol. Clients must be on v2.8+
